description: This file defines data structures and algorithms for wake word detection and command extraction. It includes types for representing speech segments, configuration options, and matching logic for wake words within transcribed speech.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of transcribed speech, including text, timing, and optional range within the source transcript.

classes.name: WakeWordGateConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for wake word detection, such as triggers and timing constraints.

classes.name: WakeWordGateMatch
classes.description: Represents a successful match of a wake word trigger, including end time, gap, and command text.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Main method to detect wake word trigger in transcript using segments and configuration.

methods.name: commandText
methods.description: Extracts command text following a trigger end time.

methods.name: matchesTextOnly
methods.description: Checks if given text contains any trigger words (case-insensitive, normalized).

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes trigger words from the beginning of input text.

methods.name: normalizeTriggers
methods.description: Converts trigger phrases into normalized token arrays for matching.

methods.name: normalizeSegments
methods.description: Converts segments into normalized tokens for matching.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a single token by trimming punctuation and case folding.
